task: Make the centre feed column scrollable (Cruddur home page)

context.problem: The home page cannot scroll. body has overflow:hidden (added to contain the body::before glow animation) and no element on the home page has overflow:auto, so any feed taller than the viewport is clipped at the bottom edge and the last posts are unreachable.
context.design: Keep body { overflow: hidden }. Make .content the single scroll container (X/Twitter model: navigation and sidebar stay fixed, the timeline scrolls). Give #root an explicit height so the height:100% chain (main -> article -> .content) resolves instead of collapsing to auto.
context.why_root_height: height:100% only works when the parent has an explicit height. React mounts into <div id="root"> which has no height rule, so every 100% below it currently resolves to auto.
context.safety_already_verified: ReplyForm wrapper is position:fixed (ReplyForm.css line 2) and is unaffected by ancestor overflow. ActivityForm's position:absolute (line 68) is contained inside its own position:relative box (line 63). DesktopNavigation and DesktopSidebar have no positioning and remain in place as flex siblings of .content.

phases.name: Read before writing
actions: Read App.css, components/ActivityFeed.css, index.css in full.

Confirm index.css contains exactly one rule whose selector is `html, body` and that it sets height, width and background-color. If the block differs from what is described in phase 3, STOP and report the actual content rather than guessing.

phases.name: Replace App.css
phases.mode: replace entire file with the content below, byte for byte

phases.name: Edit index.css
phases.mode: replace one selector only; leave every other line untouched
phases.note: Only the selector line changes. The three declarations inside the block (height: 100%; width: 100%; background-color: #121212;) stay exactly as they are. Do not touch the separate `body {` block, the body::before rule, or the keyframes.

phases.name: Edit ActivityFeed.css
phases.note: The .activity_feed rule keeps display:flex, flex-direction:column and flex-shrink:0. Nothing else in the file changes.

phases.name: Verification gates (run all; report actual output, not a summary)

commands.expect: Exactly two lines: overflow-y: auto; and overflow-x: hidden;
Exactly one line, inside the body { } block. It must still be present.
Exactly three modified files: frontend-react-js/src/App.css, frontend-react-js/src/index.css, frontend-react-js/src/components/ActivityFeed.css. No other files.
Small: roughly +8/-1 across three files. Report the real numbers.

phases.name: Report
actions: Paste the raw output of every phase-5 command.
State any deviation from this spec and why.
If any gate did not match its expectation, say so plainly. Do not report a pass you did not observe.

must_not: Do not run git add, git commit, git push, or any history-rewriting command. The operator commits.
Do not modify any file other than the three named above.
Do not remove or change body { overflow: hidden } in index.css.
Do not touch ReplyForm.css, ActivityForm.css, DesktopNavigation.css or DesktopSidebar.css.
Do not add scrollbar styling, transitions, or any change not listed in phases 2-4.
Do not invent content if a file does not match what phase 1 expects; stop and report.
verified_next_deploy: Wheel-scroll over the centre column reaches the final post.
Navigation and sidebar do not move while the feed scrolls.
Reply modal opens centred and is not clipped.
The purple glow does not produce a page-level scrollbar.
